Title: LSJ: Mata Hari and Khabar: Glory

Messages.Author: Archibald Zimonyi
Messages.Body:
Hi all,

if Mata Hari plays Khabar: Glory she is considered Assamite for the
duration of the action, hence I would say she gets untapped. She does
not get the +1 bleed as that is a continous effect.

My two questions are:

Do I understand it correctly that Mata Hari gets to be untapped as an
effect of playing Khabar: Glory?

Do I gain 4 additional pool for ousting my prey?

Thanks,

Archie

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <c773b906-d715-46e9...@u36g2000prf.googlegroup

s.com>, Archibald Zimonyi <ar...@aranzo.netg.se> writes:
>if Mata Hari plays Khabar: Glory she is considered Assamite for the
>duration of the action,

No she isn't. She's considered Assamite for the play and resolution of
the card (which happen at either end of the action).

All other effects will see her as her real clan.

>hence I would say she gets untapped.

Right, that's part of the resolution of the card.

>She does
>not get the +1 bleed as that is a continous effect.

Correct.

>Do I understand it correctly that Mata Hari gets to be untapped as an
>effect of playing Khabar: Glory?

Yes.

>Do I gain 4 additional pool for ousting my prey?

Yes.

Why wouldn't you? The card is in play. If you put it on an Assamite
who then untapped and Clan Impersonated to Brujah, would you be having
the same dilemma?
